info.title: INDUSTRIHUB API
info.description: Route handlers of the INDUSTRIHUB Next.js app (web/app/api). Success: {success:true,data,error:null,meta:{requestId,...}}. Failure: {success:false,data:null,error:{code,message,fields?}}. Authentication is the HttpOnly cookie industrihub-session set by POST /api/auth/session (HMAC-SHA256 signed; 7 days with remember, otherwise 8 hours). Every POST, PATCH and DELETE must be same-origin, otherwise 403 FORBIDDEN. A resource owned by someone else returns 404. Money is integer paise in responses. Payments use a test-mode gateway; failed, pending and cancelled payments are still HTTP 200.

remember.description: true: token valid 7 days; false: 8 hours.

password.description: Needs at least one letter and one digit.

quantity.description: Whole number from 1 to 100000, sent as text.

targetDate.description: Today or later (UTC, one day of leeway).
